stance_basis: expressed concern about errant trucks crashing into Hamlin-Garland School
summary: Corine Kuras, a private citizen residing at 1550 West Iona Terrace, testified at the hearing expressing concern about errant trucks crashing into Hamlin-Garland School as a result of the Airport Spur project. She also submitted a tape recording of Supervisor Biernat's comments on the Airport Spur, which was transcribed into the Official Transcript at her request.
complaint_summary: Corine Kuras expressed concern about errant trucks crashing into Hamlin-Garland School and submitted a tape recording of Supervisor Biernat's comments on the Airport Spur.
